title: Song
description: Individual song or track with artist, album association, duration, genre, playback statistics, and release date. Used for music streaming services, radio stations, and music databases.

artist.description: Name of the artist or band who performed the song

album.description: Name of the album this song belongs to

genre.description: Music genre of the song (e.g., Pop, Rock, Jazz, Country)

url.description: URL to the song audio file or streaming link

plays.description: Total number of times the song has been played

released_at.description: Date when the song was released
